domain: SEC Financial Filings (10-K) and AI Research Papers
description: Production evaluation corpus consisting of SEC 10-K annual reports and foundational deep learning publications with dense tables, mathematical formulations, and multi-column layouts.

documents.title: NVIDIA Corporation 2024 Form 10-K Annual Report
challenging_elements: Multi-column ASCII/Unicode tabular layout on Page 2 and Page 3
Dense numerical financial metrics across fiscal years 2022-2024
Repeating page headers and footers with page numbering
Footnote disclosures directly tied to segment revenue rows

documents.title: Apple Inc. Form 10-K Annual Report (FY 2023)
challenging_elements: Consolidated Statements of Operations and Balance Sheets with multi-year comparisons
Segment revenue breakdown across Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, Rest of Asia Pacific
Product revenue tables for iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables/Home/Accessories, and Services
Footnote disclosures for commitments, contingencies, and debt obligations

documents.title: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al.)
challenging_elements: Multi-Head Attention mathematical formulation and Scaled Dot-Product equations
Table 1 and Table 2 comparing training cost and BLEU scores across architectures
Positional encoding sinusoidal formulas and layer normalization steps
Visual model architecture diagrams and multi-column research layout

documents.filename: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition.pdf
documents.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (He et al.)
challenging_elements: Residual block formulation and identity mapping equations
Table 1, 3, 4 ImageNet classification error rates across 18, 34, 50, 101, 152 layers
Degradation analysis comparing plain networks to deep residual networks

documents.filename: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States Revision 22 (2026).pdf
documents.title: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States Revision 22 (2026)
challenging_elements: Section XVI statutory classification notes and exceptions
Multi-tier hierarchical tariff schedules and subheadings
Statistical notes detailing semiconductor wafer fabrication and mask repair equipment
